name: Cage-based Deformation for 3DGS
definition: A real-time deformation method for 3DGS that transfers deformation from a proxy point cloud (derived from Gaussians) back to the Gaussians, including splitting and covariance transformation.
summary: GSDeformer deforms 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes in real-time by splitting Gaussians to capture large bending deformations, avoiding the artifacts caused by standard mean-only optimization.
